description: This file defines the ConceptProposalHandler class, which implements the SaveHandler interface for ConceptProposal objects in the OpenMRS project. It handles setting default values such as state, creator, and dateCreated for ConceptProposal instances upon saving.

classes.name: ConceptProposalHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages actions to be performed when saving ConceptProposal objects, such as setting default state, creator, and creation date.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets default values for state, creator, and dateCreated on a ConceptProposal object if they are not already set, typically invoked during save operations.
